svg.aria-label: The same loop, on the floor. An illustration, not live data: 1 a lead lands on a Meta Lead Ads webhook, 2 the dialler bridge puts it straight into ViciDial to the next free desk, 3 speech-to-form fills the record while the agent talks, 4 sales land in client apps on Supabase, 5 reports synced every minute recount them, 6 live spend picks the creative.
